program:
app "Study" school ocean
table lesson subject pick Maths|English|Science|History|Art, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri, start time, mins num 15..180 = 45
table studied lesson ref lesson
"Today" head
each lesson where day = dayname(today) sort start
  row card
    it.start it.subject grow
    toggle it.studied
grid 5 gap 1
  each options lesson.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      dd bold align center
      each lesson where day = dd sort start as l
        stack radius 6 pad 1 fill if(l.subject = Maths, accent, if(l.subject = English, good, if(l.subject = Science, warn, soft))) tap edit l
          l.subject small bold
          l.start l.mins "min" tiny
form lesson
describe:
Study, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- lesson: subject: one of Maths, English, Science, History, Art; day: one of Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri; start: time of day; mins: number, 15 to 180, starts at 45. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- studied: lesson: a lesson. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Today".
- for each lesson where day is the weekday of today sorted by start:
  - text: its start, its subject.
  - a tick box for its studied.
- a grid of 5 columns:
  - for each choice of the day of the lesson:
    - text: the choice.
    - for each lesson where day is the choice sorted by start:
      - a group; a tap opens the lesson for editing:
        - text: the subject of the lesson.
        - text: the start of the lesson, the mins of the lesson, "min".
- a form to add a lesson.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Business costs" bag plum
table cost what text, amount money
state m date = today
let spent = sum(cost.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 200000 "Monthly budget"
monthnav m
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form cost
list cost month of m by day
describe:
Business costs, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- cost: what: text; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 200000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of cost in the month of m.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a cost.
- a list of cost in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
